title: Behavioral Equivalence Is Not Architectural Compliance: Verifying an AI-Assisted Migration
description: GitHub's 800,000-line Copilot Rust port compiled and passed its tests, yet shipped regressions. Acceptance needs behavioral evidence and decision compliance.
og_alt: Behavioral equivalence is not architectural compliance: a migration can match every output and still cross an approved boundary.
